description: Mayberry Pressure Washing LLC is a local exterior cleaning company serving homeowners, property managers, and businesses in Mount Airy and nearby Northwest North Carolina and Triad communities. Services include pressure washing, soft washing, house washing, roof washing, driveway and concrete cleaning, gutter cleaning and brightening, window cleaning, deck and fence cleaning, wood staining, gutter guard installation, and commercial exterior cleaning. We match the cleaning method to each surface, provide clear estimates, and communicate throughout the job.

services.name: job_type_id:power_pressure_washing
services.description: Professional pressure washing for durable exterior surfaces, including driveways, sidewalks, patios, concrete, brick, and other hardscapes. We match the pressure and cleaning method to the surface and property.

services.name: job_type_id:glass_and_mirror_cleaning
services.description: Glass and mirror cleaning for homes and commercial properties, with careful detailing for clear results. Scope is confirmed during the estimate based on access, pane count, screens, and the condition of the glass.

services.name: job_type_id:gutter_cleaning
services.description: Removal of leaves, debris, and buildup from accessible gutters and downspouts to help water flow correctly. Gutter brightening can also be quoted to improve stained or dirty exterior gutter faces.

services.name: job_type_id:window_cleaning
services.description: Interior and exterior window cleaning for homes and commercial properties, including glass, frames, and accessible screens as agreed in the quote. We can pair window cleaning with house washing or storefront cleaning.

services.name: job_type_id:roof_cleaning
services.description: Low-pressure roof washing designed to treat organic staining and buildup without using high pressure on shingles. The roof condition, access, landscaping, and runoff plan are reviewed before work begins.

services.name: job_type_id:rooftop_skylight_cleaning
services.description: Cleaning for accessible rooftop surfaces and skylight exteriors, with the method chosen for the roofing material, glass, pitch, and access. Scope and safety requirements are confirmed during the estimate.

services.name: job_type_id:soft_wash_cleaning
services.description: Low-pressure exterior cleaning for siding, stucco, painted surfaces, roofs, and other materials that should not be cleaned with high pressure. The cleaning solution and rinse process are matched to the surface.

services.name: House washing
services.description: Soft washing for siding, trim, soffits, porches, entry areas, and other exterior surfaces. We remove dirt and organic buildup while using a lower-pressure method suited to the home.

services.name: Driveway and concrete cleaning
services.description: Surface cleaning for driveways, sidewalks, patios, pool decks, and other concrete areas. We treat visible buildup and rinse surrounding areas for a cleaner, more even finish.

services.name: Deck and fence cleaning
services.description: Careful cleaning for wood and composite decks, railings, fences, steps, and related outdoor surfaces. The method is selected to clean buildup without unnecessary pressure damage.

services.name: Wood staining
services.description: Deck, fence, and exterior wood staining to improve appearance and help protect prepared wood surfaces. Cleaning, drying, product selection, and application scope are confirmed before the job.

services.name: Gutter brightening
services.description: Exterior gutter-face cleaning that targets dark streaks and visible staining after basic debris removal. Results depend on material condition, oxidation, and the age of the staining.

services.name: Commercial exterior cleaning
services.description: Exterior cleaning for storefronts, apartment communities, offices, sidewalks, awnings, and other commercial properties. We scope access, traffic, timing, surfaces, and safety before work begins.

services.name: Gutter guard installation
services.description: Installation of gutter guards for suitable residential gutter systems to help reduce leaf and debris buildup. We review the roofline, existing gutters, access, and product fit before quoting the work.
